reviews.comment: Professor Jordan was amazing! Pols 200 was by far my best class of freshman year. Really smart and insightful. Be ready to write and do the readings!

Professor Jordan is a very kind and understanding professor. He uses Polleveryhwere, so going to class is a good idea. His lectures are usually entertaining! I had personal things going on in life, and he was able to work with me!  10/10 recommend!
Mr Jordan was a great instructor and I really did enjoy his class. He is very passionate about what he does and wants his students to do well in his class. Overall would highly recommend this class.
Professor Jordan's lectures are engaging, making you want to go to class. Overall just read the readings and take some notes in class and you should be fine.

Dr. Jordan is a fantastic professor. It is clear he is passionate about his class and wants his students to do well. He is very fair and honest about what he expects from his students. Take him if you can!

Dr. J is super passionate about what he does. The weekly online readings were the most difficult part of the course as they are very long and then do come up on exams. He gives plenty of time on assignments and has very clear rubrics. Attendance isn't mandatory but he has graded activities in class randomly.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Jordan is honestly a gem in the political science department! He is so passionate about what he teaches and makes difficult concepts easier to understand. He did have a good amt of assignments and pop quizzes but they weren't hard and he was lenient and provided helpful feedback. Really great class and professor!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: If I tried harder towards the beginning of the semester I probably would have been able to get an A. Dr. J however was an amazing prof and works with students to help them succeed. Pop quizzes but its pretty easy to tell when they'll be an all but the first are group quizzes. Funny and entertaining.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This was one of my favorite classes I have taken in college. Dr. Jordan is an amazing professor, I highly recommend him. His lectures were always entertaining and I genuinely learned a lot in his class. He will challenge you, but if you go to class and do your work it shouldn't be difficult to get an A.

I really enjoyed this class so mcuh, he always kept things fun. He even gave us 6 extra credit points if the Dallas Stars did well! He also bumped everyone's exam grades up for our first exam and lets you take in a note card. I would definitely suggest taking good notes on the readings.

I really enjoyed Dr. J's class, he always kept things fun. He even gave us 6 extra credit points if the Dallas Stars did well! He also bumped everyone's exam grades up for our first exam and lets you take in a note card. I would definitely suggest taking good notes on the readings.
He posts lectures on Canvas but what he says in class is what will be on the tests so you HAVE to go to class. He gives extra credit based on how bad the class did on the exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Soren was an awesome teacher. He truly cares about his students and loves political science. I never thought I would enjoy this class but I did and I actually learned a lot. He doesn't try to trick you on tests its just simply a test on your knowledge. If you study, you will do well; if you don't study, you won't do well. TAKE HIM  HES AWESOME.

Soren is my favorite prof. at A&M so far. If you read and go to class his tests are easy. If you do not put in effort you proably wont do well. Soren was super funny I enjoyed going to his class and he cared about his students and learned my name. Super helpfull in office hours. His class is all being able to apply knowledge.

Tests ARE challenging but passable and not even so hard that you can't ace them. Experienced students shouldn't be scared away from Dr. Jordan just because of the reviews saying his tests are so hard. Very helpful in office hours and very passionate in class about the subjects. Put in the required time and effort and an A or a B is very realistic.

The Tests were very hard and he wasn't clear in his questions regarding government or the public in general. Would not recommend taking him. He makes lectures seem easy along with the reading and then asks the hardest possible questions.

Jordan is a good professor, his lecture notes are posted online so all you have to do is show up and listen. Three tests, non cumulative, over mostly lecture and the book material. He gives tons of extra credit to make up for the difficulty of the tests, which are mostly conceptual rather than fact based.

Soren was awesome! He's goofy and makes his lectures pretty entertaining; for POLS that is. Only 3 tests and about half of each test is over textbook material. He does offer quite a bit of extra credit. Overall, I'd take him again in a heartbeat.

Soren is very laid back and posts all lectures online so you do not have to go to class but you do have to read the book, his tests are super tough but normally everyone fails them so he gives tons of extra credit. Only 3 tests, non cumulative.

Hilarious and very sarcastic but entertaining in lecture. Tests are complex and require being able to connect ideas and concepts from class and readings. Tests are fairly difficult but not impossible.
